_comment_revB: REVISION B - P2 DELTA AFTER THE H1 CHECKPOINT (2026-07-28). H1 was approved with four directed changes (decisions.md s0): Q1 sealed enclosure with LED heat conducted through the wall; Q2 emitter set changed from the integrated RGBW 4-in-1 to 4x RGB 3-in-1 (LCSC C22434861) + 4x white discrete (LCSC C48586656), both live-verified this session; Q3 PAR-REQ-01 met by hardware plus a named carrier-firmware dither commitment; Q4 same-reel sourcing with the 24C32 fitted but shipped empty. NET EFFECT ON THIS FILE: NOTHING BELOW CHANGES VALUE, AND THAT IS A DERIVED RESULT, NOT AN OVERSIGHT. The two emitter packages publish IDENTICAL forward-voltage ranges (R 1.8-2.4 V, G/B/W 2.8-3.4 V, live-verified), so power_tree.md s1.2 re-derives the same 2S2P / 150 mA/die arrangement from scratch and lands on the same numbers: power[] +12V stays 0.75 A (design max 0.717 A worst-case-Vf, 95.6 % of the ICD s6.2 sustained ceiling, 35.9 % of the 2.0 A OCP), and all four power[] /LEDn_A entries stay 0.30 A. The channel count is CONFIRMED at four (R, G, B, W) - the RGB package carries three independently-wired dies and the white one, so a die moved between packages but no colour was added or removed (power_tree.md s1.4). thermal[] is UNCHANGED and re-validated: U301/U321/U341/U361 at 0.15 W and D301/D321/D341/D361 at 0.14 W are set by the DRIVER STAGE (the 0.14 W diode figure is the shunted-idle case, 0.45 V x 0.30 A, which is the worst case at unchanged channel current), and the emitter packages are OFF-BOARD so they never appear here. placement[] is UNCHANGED: the 8-package module mounts to the ENCLOSURE WALL, not to this board (stackup.md T-7), so the doubled package count adds nothing here; J5 stays a 10-way header on the top edge because the harness is still 4 anodes + 4 per-channel returns + /NTC_LED + a dedicated NTC sense return (blocks.md B6 records why two package families do not add an eleventh conductor - one NTC still suffices, and it belongs on an RGB package, which is the hotter of the two thermal sites at 1.035 W vs 0.383 W). BRANCH B IS NO LONGER A LIVE OPTION - H1 confirmed branch A (+12V) and the P2 delta was instructed not to reopen it; the branch-B edit recipe further down is retained only as a historical record. THE NOTCH KEEPOUT AT [6, 0, 36, 26] STAYS A HARD KEEPOUT AND MUST NOT BE REMOVED: the orchestrator is adding a --cutout flag centrally, and NOBODY is to hand-edit Edge.Cuts or shrink the outline (decisions.md OPEN-7).
_comment: P2 MERGED constraints for lumina-par (LUM-PAR-A), from research/led-driver.json + led-emitter.json + refdesign-thermal-protection.json + spec-dimming.json, reconciled with architecture/sheets.md. Baselined on ICD-01 rev A2 (0.635 mm HV clearance; s8.4 guarantees 0 V at J3 when the carrier is unprogrammed/crashed/brownout/reset). CANONICAL NET NAMES per sheets.md s2: power symbols are global and BARE (GND, +48V_SW, +12V, +3V3); every inter-sheet signal is /NAME and P4 MUST place a root-sheet local label on each so KiCad does not name it /<sheet>/NAME. THIS FILE ASSUMES BRANCH A (+12V feeds the LED stage) - the H1 recommendation in decisions.md D1. If the human selects branch B (+48V_SW), three edits are needed and nothing else: power[] +48V_SW current_a 0.25 -> pdn stays false but the net becomes real, power[] +12V drops out, and power[] /LEDn_A current_a 0.30 -> 0.175. MANDATORY P5 STEP - COORDINATE TRANSLATION: every rect in placement.keepouts and every planes[].region below is in ICD BOARD-LOCAL coordinates (origin = board top-left, x right, y down, per ICD s7.1). board_init.py does NOT place the outline at (0,0): in fixed-outline mode the origin is derived from the packed component bounding box (lib/board_swig.py line 205-211; the existing pd-trigger board's Edge.Cuts starts at 9.80, 27.51). After board_init, read reports/board_init.json.outline_bbox and TRANSLATE every rect below by (x0, y0) before P6 consumes this file. Skipping that step puts the antenna column keepout somewhere else and silently detunes the carrier's 2.4 GHz PCB antenna. planes_gen's region-coverage check gives partial cover for a forgotten translation; placement.keepouts has none. THE ANTENNA COLUMN NEEDS A SECOND, HAND-ADDED MECHANISM: ICD s7.6 forbids copper on EVERY layer at (88,25)-(100,55), and planes_gen has no void support (grep-verified) while nothing at all governs F.Cu/B.Cu copper there. The planes[].region entries below remove inner copper from the whole x>=88 strip; a KiCad rule area (keepout) over (88,25)-(100,55) on all four layers must additionally be added by hand at P5 and verified geometrically at P8. ABSENT KEYS ARE DELIBERATE. (1) GND is NOT a power entry: it is the In1 plane, and declaring it would make check_current demand IPC width on every GND stub and vias in every GND cluster; the requirement is structural instead (solid In1, per-channel harness returns, 7 connector GND pins carrying 0.10 A each). (2) diff_pairs is an EXPLICIT EMPTY LIST, which disables the check - there is no differential net on this board. (3) No impedance_ohm anywhere: no controlled-impedance net exists (PWM 4.9-9.8 kHz, I2C 400 kHz, DSPI unused, ADC paths DC), so JLC04161H-3313's controlled_impedance table is not used. TWO TRAPS CARRIED FROM THE CARRIER RUN: TRAP-1, rules_gen never reads the voltages key, so nothing makes the P7 router honour the 0.635 mm clearance around +48V_SW - add a named .kicad_dru rule keyed on A.NetName (A.Net silently matches nothing) at P5. On branch A the only 48 V copper is three J3 pads plus a stub to a DNP bleed, and the ICD s5.2 land pattern already gives 0.84 mm (1.32x), so this is cheap insurance rather than a routing constraint. TRAP-2, rules_gen puts EVERY power net into one Power netclass at the WIDEST declared width, so +12V's 0.75 A width is applied to +3V3 and to all four /LEDn_A nets and to Freerouting's DSN; here that is harmless (0.75 A is the widest and the board has room) but do not add a wider net without re-checking. P4 AMENDMENT - THE FOUR high_speed NETS ARE NOW SPELLED /control/PWMn, NOT /PWMn. The PWM lines are not inter-sheet: J4, the 100 k pull-downs R202-R205 and the U202 NAND inputs all live on `control`, so KiCad names them /control/PWM0..3. Forcing the bare /PWMn spelling needs a root crossing, and a root net whose only connection point on the root sheet is ONE sheet pin makes the root label raise ERC `label_dangling` (measured: 4 errors; a second same-named label does not help, only a real pin does, which would mean adding parts). The netlist is the authority and it says /control/PWMn, so this file now says it too - all seven high_speed consumers match on the real name. sheets.md s2's net table still prints /PWM0; p4-wiring-notes.md supersedes it.

groups.name: ch0
groups.note: COFF network (C304 COFF, R305 ROFF1 from the /LED0_A anode node, R306 ROFF2 from the driver's own VCC pin 2) must stay in this cluster: COFF sits at pin 1 with a short GND return. TPS92515HV sec 8.3.4 - do not strip. ADDED AT P4: C305 (BOOT cap, pin 4), D302 (BOOT diode, VCC->BOOT) and C306 (VCC decoupler, pin 2) are all pin-adjacent to the driver and must stay in this cluster. The BOOT loop is the high-side gate supply; stranding it is a switching defect, not a layout blemish.

groups.note: ADDED AT P4. ICD s8.2 requires the 100 k ENABLE pull-down AT THE CONNECTOR END, before any series element. R201 is schematically directly across J4-23, but it was bound to NO placement group, so the annealer was free to park it anywhere on the board. Anchored on J4 - deliberately NOT on the 'gate' group, which is anchored on U202 and would pull it the wrong way.

keepouts.reason: ICD s7.6 RJ45 relief - this rectangle is CUT AWAY (the mandatory 30x26 mm notch, ICD s7.4 anti-180-degree interlock). Declared as a keepout as well as an outline cut so P6 cannot pack a part here before the cut is verified. HARD KEEPOUT - DO NOT REMOVE. The cut itself is produced centrally by the orchestrator's --cutout flag; NOBODY is to hand-edit Edge.Cuts and NOBODY is to shrink the 100.0 x 80.0 mm outline to avoid the notch (MECH-02: ai-ee has no outline-shrink step and the P5 outline is permanent). This keepout stands whether or not the cut has been made yet

ICD s7.6 DC-DC hot zone - no LED drivers and no aluminium electrolytics. The carrier's 48->12 converter dissipates up to 1.25 W directly below in a stacked mezzanine. This board fits no electrolytics at all, so the binding effect is that all four buck channels must sit outside this rect
ICD s7.6 antenna column - NO COPPER ON ANY LAYER and no metal component. Live, because H1-Q8 closed Wi-Fi as a supported control path. Needs the hand-added KiCad rule area as well (see _comment)
ICD s7.6 recovery header - keep clear enough for a 6-way jumper lead with this board fitted, or firmware recovery requires removing the daughter
